name: The requester cannot approve their own correction
title: SC-07-11-04 The requester cannot approve their own correction
description:
Verified by the test cases listed as steps. The Gherkin steps were not executed one by one.

Given the manager requested a cancellation of a liability
When the same manager tries to approve it
Then the approval is rejected with status 403
And the liability is unchanged
